notes.title: Where is the NSFW content? Here!
notes.notes:
Hello, guys!

To keep our goal of delivering our games to a bigger audience, Fallen Bear's main page has only the SFW version of the game. For those who want explicit sexual content (aka pornography scenes!), you NEED to download Fallen Bear's 18+ FOR FREE on its DLC page. 

Don't forget about that because it has a lot of lewd content!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1959300/Burrow_of_the_Fallen_Bear_NSFW_Edition/

                                               ----------------- BUG FIX -----------------
If you have been facing a bug in which you have downloaded Fallen Bear's NSFW DLC but you don't find the NSFW content, check out how to fix it. 

[olist]
[*] If your game has updated to version 1.0.2, try F11 and delete all your save files. If you are on 1.0.1 (it doesn't matter if it's A or B), press F12 and delete all your save files.
[/olist]

notes.title: The Traveling Doctor has arrived at the camp. Meet Boris!
notes.notes:
Boris, aka 'brown bear doctor', is a kind doctor whose goal is to be able to help the adventurers in their mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42292858/45b327ce0f3674991577c9082da80dc1ef8c7779.png[/img]

He dreamed once of being a Furry Hero, but due to misfortunes of fate, he felt enlightened by divine clarity and decided to help people only by healing them.

Will he help everyone even when they reveal their real goal of exploring the Fallen Bear’s Burrow?

Boris is the last character of Fallen Bear's crew, so wishlist the game to get messages about it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1949440/Burrow_of_the_Fallen_Bear_A_Gay_Furry_Visual_Novel/

Also, we're getting closer to launching the game trailer and its first demo officially. If you want to play our first draft build, you can join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url]. Don't forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll]Steam[/url] page to get the latest news.

Male Doll Team

notes.title: A mercenary has arrived at the camp! Meet Ulfric
notes.notes:
Ulfric, aka Silver Hunter, is a mercenary who has been arrested countless times and now has arrived at Fallen Bear’s Burrow seeking treasures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42292858/a328505f91a8058b637dbf8c0962b701eae094fd.png[/img]

With an unknown past, he hates the Furry Heroes. However, he will meet two people who are related to them: Krile and Grivoth and unexpected things can happen because of that.

Will Ulfric change his opinion about the Furry Heroes after meeting a young adventurer who dreams to be a Hero and a researcher who works where the Heroes were trained?

Get some answers by playing our first draft build in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url]. Join it, stay tuned, and don't forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/maledoll]Steam[/url] page to get the latest news.

Male Doll Team

notes.title: The vigilante has arrived! Meet Sylvester
notes.notes:
Adventurers keep arriving to investigate the Fallen Bear’s Burrow’s mysteries and on its way, Krile will meet Sylvester, his old friend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42292858/9cff7bf2f471881b87a0a89b2162716c59b05998.png[/img]

Seeking magical creatures to get their stones and help his cubs, Sylvester is the leader of a marginal clan who has inspired Krile to become an adventurer because of his 'Robin Hood's spirit'. 

His vigilante life has made him have access to information about a lot of people and he may have important things to say about Krile's potential partners.

But some questions are still in the air: will Krile want this type of information when he may fall in love with the adventurers? Will Sylvester leave Krile alone in case Krile's possible partners have done something that he doesn't approve of?

You guys can find these answers already because we've released our first draft build in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url]. Join it, stay tuned, and don't forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/maledoll]Steam[/url] page.

Male Doll Team

notes.title: The researcher has arrived at the camp! Meet Grivoth
notes.notes:
It’s time to reveal our second character who will be present in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1949440/Burrow_of_the_Fallen_Bear_A_Gay_Furry_Visual_Novel/]Burrow of the Fallen Bear[/url]! Grivoth is a high-rank researcher who works at the Bodenius Tower, one of the most important research centers of the Furland Kingdom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42292858/9d3138abc997444738a4a38b6555427bd5749afa.png[/img]

He has dedicated part of his life to scientific projects with his friend Alius (Krile’s mentor in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1392760/Furry_Heroes/]Furry Heroes[/url] game) and one of them is being recognized as the closest one capable of breaking Furry Heroes’ curses.

Named as ‘R Project’, Grivoth has discovered that the properties found in the dust created by his project are highly similar to the energy discovered at the Burrow of the Fallen Bear’s seal. Now, he has arrived at the camp to investigate it.

However, his egocentric personality can create barriers to achieve his personal goal, after all, no one knows the dangers of the Burrow. Will he be able to work together with unknown adventurers when he can have the opportunity to go down in history?

Stay tuned to meet the other characters by following our Itch.io page!

Male Doll Team
